newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Reliastar cut to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Reliastar cut to hold.

text.p: Dain Bosworth said Thursday it cut its rating on ReliaStar Financial Corp to hold from buy due to recent price appreciation.
-- Shares of ReliaStar have increased more than 15 percent in the last month and have surpassed the price target of $68 a share, Dain said.

-- "We still feel ReliaStar's fundamentals are intact and are downgrading the shares on price appreciation only," Dain said in a report. "Based on our current outlook, if the stock pulls back into the mid-$60s, we will revisit our investment rating."
